title: API tokens
intro: Personal tokens let scripts, CI jobs and AI assistants (Claude, Codex) use Workloom from a terminal. A token never has more power than you do, and it stops working the moment you lose access or revoke it.
docsLink: Read the API and MCP documentation
name: Name
namePlaceholder: For example, CI or Claude on my laptop
scopeRead: Read workspaces, projects, members and tasks
needScope: Choose at least one kind of access.
createdHint: It is shown only once. Workloom keeps a hash, so a lost token cannot be recovered — revoke it and create another.
copyFailed: Copy failed — select the token and copy it manually.
snippetClaude: claude mcp add --transport http workloom {{origin}}/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLOOM_TOKEN"
failed: That did not work. Try again.
